summary: In this Goodful Make It Vegan Marathon episode, host Merle enlists her friend Arya to hunt for the best vegan chocolate chip cookies in the LA area, then returns to the kitchen to recreate and veganize a chocolate chip cookie together. The show expands into a broader plant-based tasting and cooking spree, including a burger segment (featuring a Monty's-style vegan burger and a homemade vegan patty using tofu, mushrooms, beets, and vital wheat gluten), a cashew-based mac and cheese, and a vegan sushi project that mimics tuna and eel using tomatoes and eggplant. Interludes include live trivia and taste tests with quick verdicts (e.g., the Merlio cookie is ranked a perfect 10 by Merle, while Erin McKenna’s cookie scores around 7.75). Across segments, the episode showcases practical vegan substitutions (coconut oil instead of butter, fruit purees and arrowroot instead of eggs, non-dairy milks, vegan cheese substitutes) and a playful emphasis on approachable, DIY vegan meals that aim to satisfy non-vegan appetites and encourage experimentation at home.
